name: Foundations of Cybersecurity
description: Provides students with a basic appreciation and understanding of the core concepts of information security. Topics include concepts for confidentiality, integrity and availability; introduction to cybercrimes and security issues; threats to information systems and devices; cryptographic primitives such as symmetric and asymmetric cryptography; core problems such as random number generation, entropy, and key distribution; and common topics such as security protocols and public-key infrastructures.
